text: Which wills and estates law firms in Brisbane Northside (Chermside & North Lakes) specialise in contesting a will, Family Provision Applications (FPA), and estate litigation?

sections.text:
For **Brisbane Northside, including Chermside and North Lakes**, the strongest matches based on their published practice areas are:

| Firm | Why it fits | Northside relevance |
|---|---|---|
| **The Estate Lawyers** | Specialises exclusively in Queensland wills and estates, including contesting a will, Family Provision Applications, executor disputes, will interpretation and estate litigation.[3] | Brisbane office; handles Queensland matters statewide. |
| **Armstrong Legal** | Dedicated contested-wills team handling challenges and defences, capacity, undue influence, fraud, FPAs, executor removal and estate-administration disputes.[2] | Brisbane service; suitable for North Lakes and Chermside clients. |
| **Maurice Blackburn** | Handles inheritance and will disputes, with Brisbane lawyers and a listed North Lakes office/practitioner.[4] | Particularly convenient if a local North Lakes consultation is important. |
| **Go To Court Lawyers** | Connects clients with wills-and-estates lawyers serving North Lakes and Moreton Bay; advertised matters include FPAs, invalid-will challenges, undue influence, lack of capacity and executor-removal applications.[8] | Direct North Lakes coverage, although it operates as a lawyer-matching service rather than a single dedicated local firm. |
| **Thynne + Macartney** | Handles estate litigation, FPAs, testamentary-capacity disputes, undue influence and suspicious circumstances; it also has Queensland-accredited succession-law expertise.[1] | Brisbane CBD rather than Northside, but a strong specialist option for complex litigation. |
| **Aitken Whyte Lawyers** | Acts in will challenges, FPAs and estate litigation, including preparing claims, mediation and trial representation; it specifically services surrounding areas including Redcliffe and Caboolture.[7] | Brisbane-based and relevant to Brisbane’s northern suburbs. |
| **Ryan Murdoch O’Regan** | Handles will-validity challenges, further-provision claims/FPAs, will interpretation and broader deceased-estate litigation, including court proceedings and mediation.[6] | Brisbane firm; confirm current Northside appointment arrangements. |
| **Rostron Carlyle Lawyers** | Advertises contesting wills, family-provision claims, will-validity disputes, mediation and estate litigation.[5] | Brisbane CBD office; accessible from Chermside and North Lakes. |

**Best shortlist:**  
- For a **specialist contested-estates practice**: **The Estate Lawyers** or **Armstrong Legal**.  
- For a **North Lakes option**: **Maurice Blackburn** or **Go To Court Lawyers**.  
- For **complex Supreme Court litigation**: **Thynne + Macartney**, **Ryan Murdoch O’Regan**, or **Aitken Whyte**.

When contacting firms, ask specifically whether the solicitor regularly handles **Queensland Succession Act 1981 Family Provision Applications**, will-validity challenges, mediation and Supreme Court proceedings—not merely standard estate planning. Also ask about limitation dates, costs, conditional/no-win-no-fee availability and whether the firm acts for claimants, executors or both.
